decision: ms and s are lexer suffixes, like deg. A bare number in a time position means seconds. Whole sub-second milliseconds print as Nms. Everything else prints as seconds. clip: prints after each.

decision: Anims sit in a side table on the module, copied on use like styles. They are not values. play looks the name up there. clip == idle therefore still sees idle as a word.

decision: Keys are evenly spaced unless at: gives fractions of the key duration, from 0 to 1, nondecreasing. The default is uniform Catmull-Rom with duplicated ends. ease replaces that spline. Numbers, angles, vectors, and sizes move in value space. Colors move in OKLab. Words, components, and booleans step. Any other kind is E0320.
why: One interpolation per kind, and no guess. A 0 to 360 spin passes through the intermediates. Ease does not stack on the spline.

decision: profile: accepts vector, svg, raster, or auto on every target. An unknown word or a non-word value is E0206. An explicit profile:vector or profile:svg on a .png or .gif target is E0206. A manifest vector or svg default still lets raster targets build.
why: A raster target cannot honor a vector profile, so an explicit one is an author mistake. A project-wide default must not break every .png target (#22).
